title: Pick the right column types
why_it_matters: Wrong types cause rounding bugs and messy data later.
explanation: Use text for words, integer for whole numbers, boolean for true or false, and timestamptz for date and time. For money, store integer cents instead of decimals. A uuid primary key with a default creates ids for you.
code:
create table bookings (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  guest_name text not null,
  nights integer not null,
  total_cents integer not null,
  created_at timestamptz default now()
);
try_it: Sketch a table for something you build, and choose a type for each column.
